string-array.name: novidades
string-array.item: Real volume on LG NetCast TVs (2013) over the network: sleep timer, bedtime limit, voice and alarm
Series: 10-second countdown before the next episode, “Still watching?” after 3 in a row, and “Turn off the TV when this ends” in the ▼ menu
Movies and series try again by themselves when the connection drops, subtitle size in the ▼ menu, and the details page works offline
Screensaver answers the remote: ◀ ▶ move through the cards, OK dismisses a notice or pauses the music, and a “now playing” card
Screensaver photos from a network folder (computer, NAS or Nextcloud): open the folder in “Network” and choose “Use these photos”
More apps on the home screen now show a short description under their name
Search: at the end of the results, continue the same search on YouTube, Netflix or Prime Video
Live TV: each account can have a second XMLTV guide that only fills channels left without a schedule
“My team” reminders now see matches up to 7 days ahead, not just the next 14 hours
Up to 3 named timers at once, plus a stopwatch (Hourglass); Home shows the next one
Alarms can wake you with the last live TV channel (a radio from your list works too)
Kids PIN: unlock channels and bedtime without giving away the panel PIN
Daily screen time: when it runs out, only allowed apps open (Extras)
Calendar with all the TV\'s Google accounts together
“Network” looks like a catalog: poster and synopsis beside the list, Recently added, Search on Jellyfin, Emby and Plex, and a folder plays the next video or song
Settings: each Extras switch now lives in its own tab, under “More options”
Settings: lines with a QR code that opens the web panel straight on scenes, Home Assistant, photos, family board, my team or router
Quick panel: choose its tiles and their order (Settings > Appearance), with new Night filter and DNS tiles
Type with accents from your phone and from Claude (ç, ã, é arrive as typed)
Guest Wi-Fi as a QR: Settings > Guests and routines; in guest mode, Wi-Fi in the quick panel shows the QR
The nightly backup now checks every night that the saved copy would restore
Settings > System > What gets used: screens and settings by use, counted only on this TV
Internet: a phone alert when it comes back (how long it was down and the likely cause), a monthly summary in the panel, and an alert when storage is filling up
Quick panel: the TV\'s latest alerts (rain, notes, maintenance) and the shopping list, crossed out with OK
Movies and series follow the TV’s language: “dubbed” means audio in that language, and automatic and online subtitles come in it too
Series: mark the opening once in the ▼ menu (start and end) and the next episodes offer “Skip opening · OK”

string-array.name: roteiro_titulos
string-array.item: Press HOME
Open Home from the quick panel
Open Settings > Automations
Open Scenes from the quick panel, or say “Ok Google, open Scenes”
Tap, hold and double tap a free button on the remote
Make a test scene for “movie paused”, then pause a movie
Let an episode reach the end (or skip to the last minute)
Play music, wait for the screensaver, then press ◀ ▶ and OK
In “Network”, open a folder with photos and choose “Use these photos in the screensaver”
On the home screen, move to an app you installed (e.g. a file manager)
Open Search, type a movie name and pick “Search … on YouTube” at the end
In the panel, add an account with a second guide link, then open Live TV
With your team saved in “My team”, open Live TV once, then look at the reminders in the panel
Say “Ok Google, open Avisar em 5 minutos”, then “open Avisar em 10 minutos”
Say “Ok Google, open Ampulheta” and pick Start stopwatch
In a test alarm, set Sound: Last live TV channel
Settings > Parental control > Kids PIN; then show a hidden category with it
Extras: turn on Daily screen time with 30 min and open an app
Open the calendar (OK on the date at the top)
In “Network”, open a Jellyfin or Plex server, try Search and Recently added, and play a video from a folder
Open Settings > Screen and power and go to the end
Open Settings > Guests and routines > Scenes from your phone, and scan the code
In Settings > Appearance > Quick panel tiles, show Night filter and move it to the top; then hold HOME
Type “ação” in the TV search from the phone panel
Set Settings > Guests and routines > Guest Wi-Fi, turn guest mode on and press Wi-Fi in the quick panel
Settings > System > Automatic backup > Back up now
Open Settings > System > What gets used
Open the quick panel and scroll to the bottom
Play a foreign movie set to “Original with subtitles” (TV in Portuguese)
In an episode, use ▼ to mark the opening start and end, then open the next episode

string-array.name: roteiro_perguntas
string-array.item: Did it go back to the home screen?
Are the cards grouped by room, clear of the hints at the bottom?
Do your routines and alarms show up there, and can you edit one?
Did the Scenes list open?
Did each one do what you set for it?
Did the test scene run?
Did “Next episode” count down from 10, and did Cancel keep you on the series page?
Did the cards get highlighted and did OK pause the music?
Did those photos show up in the next screensaver?
Does the line under its name say what it does, in the TV’s language?
Did YouTube open with that search (or at least open)?
Do channels that had no schedule now show programs, while the others stay the same?
Does a match more than a day away show up in the list?
Does the Home pill show the nearest timer with “+1”?
Does the pill show the stopwatch counting up, and does OK on it stop it and show the time?
At alarm time, did the channel play, getting louder slowly?
Did the kids PIN unlock it, and does the panel PIN still work?
After 30 min, did the app go back to Home with the notice?
Do events from all the TV\'s accounts show up?
Did the poster and synopsis show up, and did the next video start after 10 s?
Are Night filter, Gentle shutdown and the other switches there, under “More options”?
Did the phone open the panel already on the Scenes card?
Is Night filter the first tile of the panel?
Did it arrive with the ç and the ã?
Did the QR show up, and did a phone camera connect?
Does the result say “restore check passed”?
Do the screens you opened today show up?
Do the TV alerts and the shopping list show, and does OK cross out an item?
Did Portuguese subtitles turn on by themselves, as before?
Did “Skip opening · OK” show up in the opening, and did OK jump past it without pausing?
